title: FiniteFreeLocalStalkMapLift
statement: Let $(X,\mathcal O_X)$ be a ringed space, $\mathcal F,\mathcal G$ module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], $x\in U\subseteq X$ with $U$ open, $I$ a finite set, $A=\mathcal O_U^{\oplus I}$ and $f:A\to\mathcal F|_U$ a module morphism [def-pur-localized-ringed-site]. Given an $\mathcal O_{X,x}$-linear map $\chi:\mathcal F_x\to\mathcal G_x$ [def-weil-pbc-module-stalk], [def-pc-module-stalk-functor], there are an open $x\in V\subseteq U$ and $\psi:A|_V\to\mathcal G|_V$ such that for every $x\in W\subseteq V$ and $s\in A(W)$, $\psi_W(s)_x=\chi(f_W(s)_x)$. No relation-annihilation or quotient descent is asserted.

source.place: Tag 01CP, lemma-stalk-internal-hom, third paragraph; finite-coordinate construction and its finite-type vanishing argument.

proof.text: Evaluate f on each basis inclusion at the terminal object of Over U. Apply chi to the germs. Mathlib TopCat.Presheaf.exists_le_germ_eq gives representatives t_k on D_k contained in U. Set V = U intersect the finite infimum of the D_k. Opens.coe_iInf proves x belongs to V, also for the empty index type.

For each k, form a compatible section sigma_k of G.over V by restricting t_k to each object of Over V. Naturality follows from map_comp_apply and uniqueness of arrows of opens. Use unitHomEquiv.symm and overMapUnitIso to get g_k from the restricted unit. Define psi as the finite sum of the restricted coordinate projections free_pi_k followed by g_k. All objects and maps are actual constructions from Mathlib and the proved source-library free-sheaf coordinate maps.

The proved SheafOfModules.freeSectionsLinearEquiv in WeilConjectures.Mathlib.Algebra.Category.ModuleCat.Sheaf.Free decomposes every section s into the sum of its coordinates times the basis inclusions. unitHomEquiv and sections_property compute f on a basis coordinate as that coordinate times the restriction of f(e_k), and compute g_k as the coordinate times the restriction of t_k. sum_val_app_apply expands psi. Apply additivity, PresheafOfModules.germ_smul, linearity of chi, and germ_res_apply; the representative equations ht_k give equality term by term. The empty family gives empty sums, hence the same proof.

theorem exists_finiteFree_local_stalkMap_lift
    (X : RingedSpace.{u}) (F G : Modules X) (x : X)
    (U : Opens X) (hxU : x ∈ U) (I : Type u) [Finite I]
    (f : SheafOfModules.free (R := ((sheafCompose (Opens.grothendieckTopology X)
      (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u} RingCat.{u})).obj X.sheaf).over U) I ⟶ F.over U)
    (χ : (moduleStalkFunctor X x).obj F →ₗ[X.presheaf.stalk x]
      (moduleStalkFunctor X x).obj G) :
    ∃ (V : Opens X) (hxV : x ∈ V) (i : V ⟶ U)
      (ψ : (SheafOfModules.overMap ((sheafCompose (Opens.grothendieckTopology X)
      (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u} RingCat.{u})).obj X.sheaf) i).obj
        (SheafOfModules.free (R := ((sheafCompose (Opens.grothendieckTopology X)
      (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u} RingCat.{u})).obj X.sheaf).over U) I) ⟶ G.over V),
      ∀ (W : Opens X) (j : W ⟶ V) (hxW : x ∈ W)
        (s : (SheafOfModules.free (R := ((sheafCompose (Opens.grothendieckTopology X)
      (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u} RingCat.{u})).obj X.sheaf).over U) I).val.obj
          (op (Over.mk (j ≫ i)))),
        TopCat.Presheaf.germ G.val.presheaf W x hxW
          (ψ.val.app (op (Over.mk j)) s) =
        χ (TopCat.Presheaf.germ F.val.presheaf W x hxW
          (f.val.app (op (Over.mk (j ≫ i))) s))
